messages:
aisha_cs: Quick sync — Solstice Health private deploy. Preflight flagged a few gaps: S3 audit delivery not configured, KMS rotation plan not documented, and we don't have the IAM cross-account role ARN for ops. Cutover ETA 2026-04-02, want to get these squared away this week.

sam_onboard: I can take the S3/Terraform ask. Does customer want logs in a dedicated bucket or in their existing org bucket?

diego_infra: dedicated is safer for now. Also they need the VPC egress CIDR for our NAT gateway rules — ask them for the on-prem ranges. 

diego_infra: Terraform snippet we give customers (paste into their infra):
```hcl
resource "aws_s3_bucket" "solstice_audit" {
  bucket = "solstice-priv-audit-logs"
  acl    = "log-delivery-write"
  versioning { enabled = true }
}

resource "aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block" "block" {
  bucket = aws_s3_bucket.solstice_audit.id
  block_public_acls       = true
  block_public_policy     = true
  ignore_public_acls      = true
  restrict_public_buckets = true
}
```

lisa_security: For KMS — we need: CMK ARN, rotation cadence (we require auto-rotation enabled or a documented manual rotation process), and key policy that allows our service principal to Encrypt/Decrypt for log delivery. Also retention: customer requested 1y, we need confirmation they have SIEM ingest for 90-day hot logs.

mateo_eng: On IAM cross-account: we expect a role named `RedwoodPrivAccess` with trust for `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodService` (placeholder). If they want a narrower policy we can accept a scoped policy; just need the role ARN and a test principal.

aisha_cs: Action items: Sam -> send Terraform + checklist to Solstice contact (Maya). Diego -> confirm NAT/gw egress CIDR request template. Lisa -> draft KMS key policy snippet + retention guidance. Mateo -> provide minimal IAM trust policy example. I'll own renewal risk note (they're flagged because SOC2 evidence hasn't been uploaded).

sam_onboard: sending to Maya now, cc @mike-support for binary artifact access. Template message: "Hi Maya — attached are the S3/Terraform bits we recommend. Please confirm bucket name + whether you want cross-account access. Also share the on-prem egress CIDRs"

lisa_security: KMS key policy pointer (to send to customer): make sure `kms:Encrypt`, `kms:Decrypt`, `kms:GenerateDataKey` are allowed for the service principal and that `kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion` is NOT permitted by default. Also enable key rotation if using AWS-managed CMK or document manual rotation every 12 months.

diego_infra: NAT/gw egress ask for customer (one-liner to paste): "Please provide the source CIDR ranges for on-prem -> cloud egress and any additional public IPs that need to be whitelisted for webhooks or SIEM egress (CSV)."

mateo_eng: Minimal IAM trust policy example to share:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodService" },
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
      "Condition": {}
    }
  ]
}
```

aisha_cs: Timeline: get docs + ARNs by EOD Thursday so SRE can run a dry-run Friday. If we miss EOD we push cutover 1 week. This is also a renewal risk: if Soc2 artifact not uploaded by next week we escalate to AM.

reminder-bot: Reminder set: "Solstice preflight artifacts due" — due 2026-03-26 17:00 UTC :alarm_clock:

sam_onboard: FYI Maya replied — she prefers a dedicated bucket. Asking for the CIDRs now.

lisa_security: Noted. I'll draft a short checklist YAML we can attach to the ticket (retention, rotation, key policy, SIEM endpoint).

aisha_cs: Perfect. I'll update the enablement calendar and schedule a 30m runbook walk-through with Solstice + SRE on Friday 09:30 PT. Thanks team :thumbsup:

sam_onboard: Sending artifacts to Maya and will paste the Terraform + IAM examples into the ticket.

diego_infra: I'll follow up with ops SRE to stand by for the dry-run.

mateo_eng: I'll craft a minimal test plan for AssumeRole validation (sts:AssumeRole -> s3:ListBucket on the audit bucket).

aisha_cs: Closing the thread here — will reopen if any blocker.
